scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all orders and all angles; numerical convex-hull and moment checks are finite diagnostics, not exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Two convex regular planar polygons with positive radii and Haar-uniform relative rotation; no claim that fixed-angle low-order cases, general mixed-area identities or algorithms are new. Earlier equivalent formulas in older virial-coefficient literature remain possible. No independent audit or priority certification.
title: Arithmetic resonance in the excluded area of two rotated regular polygons
